results.summary:
Docs only — the adoption + messaging half of ADR-004, in three files, with no code or behaviour touched. Draft PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/70 (branch worktree-kb-67-1).

**docs/manual-mode.md** (new, 210 lines) is the day-one loop with no dispatcher running anywhere: init/doctor; `create` (ready with no open blocker, todo with one, `--triage` before either); list/show/serve as the board view; `claim` (lock ref, attempt marked `manual`, the export line, `held` + exit 2 on a second claim); `hkb context` presented as the exact prompt a dispatched worker would get, not a summary; branch + `Closes #n` PR; one terminal verb, with `complete` on an open PR landing in *review*. Then the four things only hand mode raises: (1) the heartbeat contract — a hand attempt is judged by `stale_after` (3600s, `dispatch.stale_after`) and `max_runtime` (3600s, card `kb.max_runtime` first) and nothing else, a reclaim counts as a failure so `max_retries` still ends in blocked + `kb:needs-human`, and the honest half, that only a tick enforces any of it; (2) `hkb promote` as the by-hand promote step, since nothing promotes itself with no tick — plus the fact that `hkb claim` never checks the status; (3) `hkb dispatch --max 0` as the reconcile-only tick (reconcile + promote + reclaim + sweep, claims and launches nothing), which must run from a shell with no `KB_TASK` exported; (4) launching your own agent with `KB_TASK` set, which turns on the `Stop` and `PreToolUse` hooks in that session — hence `KB_PROFILE`, because with no profile named the allowlist is only hkb/git/gh plus builtins and the agent's `npm test` is denied. Ends with the roadmap migration as a prompt for an agent, the reasoning for no `hkb import` parser, and the adoption ladder as a table.

**README.md**: new "Who runs a board: the seats" section between How-it-works and What-it-costs, wording carried from ADR-004's Decision (operator = the human; dispatcher = a tick, not an agent and not an orchestrator; worker = any harness), closing on the ladder rather than repeating the hand/autonomous sentence verbatim. It folds in the two bolded How-it-works bullets that said the same things (old README.md:41 and :44); that list keeps its card/edge/lock bullets and gains "A handoff is a comment" in their place, so the mechanism list stays four bullets and the seats live in one section. The autonomous three-command quickstart stays first, with an "### Or drive it by hand" subsection directly after it carrying both required sentences. New Docs-list entry.

**skills/kanban/references/protocol.md**: the three seats condensed to a five-line block above the glossary, ending on "hand mode and autonomous mode are the same protocol with a different dispatcher — you, or the tick". The glossary's lead sentence was rewritten so it introduces the table (what each word is *not*) instead of restating the seats a paragraph later.

Every CLI claim in the doc was read out of the code first: `--max 0` reaching `budget = min(0, slots)` (src/dispatch.js:511) while reconcile/promote/reclaim/sweep run unconditionally; the manual-vs-remote reclaim branch #65 added (src/dispatch.js:427); `stale_after`/`max_runtime_default` = 3600 (src/board.js:97-98); `manual: !flags.spawn` and the export line (src/cli.js:421,427); create's ready/todo/triage rule (src/lifecycle.js:355-365); promote's forced ready (src/lifecycle.js:388-398); the KB_TASK dispatch guard (src/cli.js:431); and the PreToolUse allowlist collapsing to hkb/git/gh + SAFE_BUILTINS when KB_PROFILE is unset (src/hook.js:31-45, src/model.js:432-478).
